stage: Recorded after inspecting all18uninformative and12calibrated population conditions,before the paired phase experiment
purpose: Check the conditional fitted-index phase calculation,including finite-size behavior,not claim a large practical gain or estimate a novel tuning rule

dimension_rule: Round m times each of aligned_boundary-0.08,aligned_boundary,midpoint,external_boundary,external_boundary+0.08;retain all distinct positive slope counts. Same total slope count in each paired model.
